prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: 1440×900 desktop landing-page north-star comp
Primary request: Design a premium fictional general contractor landing page named NORTHLINE BUILD CO. translated through the grammar of a full-viewport vertical project feed.
Surface structure: one edge-to-edge completed residential renovation photograph fills almost the whole first viewport; a minimal narrow brand/navigation line sits at top; a service name and one-sentence project caption anchor lower left over a soft black scrim; one large “REQUEST AN ESTIMATE” control and a vertical rail of three labeled project/service actions sit at right; the beginning of the next project is visibly waiting below as a snapped sequence. This must read unmistakably as a contractor conversion website, not a social-media app.
Style/medium: high-fidelity web UI comp, desktop landscape.
Color palette: near-black #11110F, chalk white #F8F5ED, fired orange #E76B3C, muted sage #8B938B.
Materials/textures: edge-to-edge warm project photography, soft low black scrim, crisp chalk-white interface marks.
Typography: practical compact grotesk with one confident condensed headline.
Text (verbatim): “NORTHLINE BUILD CO.”, “KITCHENS MADE FOR REAL LIFE.”, “Whole-home renovations, additions, and new builds.”, “REQUEST AN ESTIMATE”, “01 RENOVATIONS”, “02 ADDITIONS”, “03 NEW BUILDS”, “NEXT PROJECT”.
Constraints: no fabricated testimonials, star ratings, years-in-business claims, license numbers, awards, likes, comments, follower counts, or numerical project claims; no rounded pill buttons; no gradients except the functional photo scrim; no phone frame. Keep text crisp and legible. One dominant move only: the full-viewport finished project image.
Avoid: mobile mockup, social engagement icons, poster-only composition, 3D device frame, illegible invented text, stock SaaS layout, bento grid, glassmorphism, watermark.
